bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional on saved cohort, folds, selected genes and trained models; genes may be dependent. Not uncertainty over new cohorts or model retraining.

legacy_pooled_caveat: Pooled correlation uses all 981 genes while legacy pergene column uses 581 selective genes. The matched-set pooled correlation cannot be recovered without labels/predictions.

symbol_root_heuristic.caveat: Unvalidated gene-symbol-root heuristic; feature correlations selected on full cohort; descriptive hypothesis generation only.

fold_source: results/fold_assignments.csv (archived partitions used by the original experiment)
